title: Cursor/p111 line7 query price 0141
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Negative audit of one postquery continuation. No new κ. Selected conditional κ stays `781451/250000000`.

For Rohan Arun's draft PR #1525 at `90d39a5603c7fbfd8d8d957e9732d9b6ebd6317f`, puncture 0 builds `q = (c61 + c63 + c31 + c256) / 2`, and the copied query is the line `span(7)`. The triangular substitution

- column 61 becomes twice itself,
- columns 63, 31 and 256 each lose column 61,

reproduces all 112 original scatter linear forms (each a vector on the 704 roles) and keeps all 62 dirty columns visible. It uses 230 nonzero ADD entries instead of 176. The extra 54 split as `+10` on column 63 (overlap 8, of which 4 cancel) and `+22` on each of the disjoint columns 31 and 256.

PR1060 `model.move` admits a frame change only when the old frame is contained in the new one. `contained((7,), ())` is false, so that constructor rejects moving the query from `span(7)` to the zero frame. Granting a rank-1 copy instead changes the already-paid local profile `{1: 4, 8: 1}` into `{1: 5, 8: 1}`. For every positive integer power tariff the new multiset costs exactly 1 more. The 54 ADDs are further nonnegative scalar cost on this matrix.

This is not a lower bound for every scatter, and it does not cancel the dirty coefficients. A map that equals the original scatter keeps every dirty column, because each of the 62 columns is nonzero in at least one original output.

Remaining obligations: a continuation that consumes the line-7 query directly; any other correction matrix; section B; whole-call owners; precision, tape, compiler and outer admission.

## Task and overlap

Scientific base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. The word and centre seed are byte copies of PR #1525; that head is not an ancestor of this base, so `SOURCES.json` pins them at `af24d3b04e9d93906ed3c5a6262972fecfe5388a` on this branch. Fork draft, opened because this session cannot open an upstream PR: https://github.com/unpaidmoon/integer-mult-bounds/pull/139

Task: `joint-query-controller`, priority revision 8. Scope: **refined**. The catalogue asks whether a changed query demand or caller can remove real work. This package answers only the triangular zero-frame canonicalization of the exact PR #1525 puncture-0 / pivot-61 query. Taken as eligible handoff item 10: Discussion #1166 comment 19143427.

`python3 -B scripts/find_overlap.py` against `CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds`, cache fetched 2026-11-03T13:38:51Z (572 open PRs, complete) and 2026-11-03T13:39:51Z (6634 discussion records, complete). Closed PR bodies were not fetched.

Nearest overlap:

- Discussion #1166 comment 19143427 (JoyboyBrian) already stated the triangular identity, the 230-versus-176 census, and the conditional bill from `4 H1 + H8` to `5 H1 + H8`. Its checker was local-only (`/tmp/r10-p111-gate.py`). Comment 19143455 is an index line for that same stop. This PR publishes a replay and checks the constructor rejection the note left as a missing contract. The support split is new checked arithmetic, not a new identity.
- Open draft PR #1525 is the predecessor, not a duplicate of this price check.
- Open PR #1900 is a different P111 plane-query construction.
- Discussion #3930 uses `span(7)` for a warp-0 entrance on a different word.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only. Both of these passed:

```sh
python3 -B research/p111-line7-query-price/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p111-line7-query-price
```

First line: `PASS_P111_LINE7_QUERY_PRICE delta_adds 54 dirty_visible 62 line_to_zero_move False NO_NEW_KAPPA`.

Metadata: `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p111-line7-query-price outcome=negative-result`.

`python3 -O -B research/p111-line7-query-price/verify.py` also passed. Checks use explicit exceptions, so `-O` does not disable them. Failure controls: omitting the three partner corrections changes an output, and `contained((7,), ())` is false.

Not run: section B, the Clifford compiler, Lean, native replay, and `scripts/research_selected_baseline.py`. Word SHA-256 `e8e6e78ff7422275c38324499e1f33fb2ecd30de9503aef2b8f1ee80d8c4df8e`.

## Credit

Word, centre seed and query formula: Rohan Arun, PR #1525, with the PR1297 / PR1134 / PR1060 lineage in that package's NOTICE. The triangular relation, the 230-versus-176 census, and the conditional profile bill are JoyboyBrian's, comment 19143427. Frame containment is PR1060 `model.py`. Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0. No independent human review.

## Open next questions

1. Can a continuation whose 22 query receivers stay at `span(7)` until their original final frames are restored beat `{1: 4, 8: 1}` after every restoration cost is charged? First step: name the receivers and one restored bill.
2. Does any other correction matrix for the same puncture-0 query improve the local profile? First step: exhibit one matrix and recompute the ADD census.
